7.name: Wicket's Driving Lesson
7.overview: Mr. Bean begins to grow fed up of Mrs. Wicket continuously relying on him as her personal taxi driver to go from place to place, so he comes up with an invention to quickly teach her the basics of driving. Eventually, Mr. Bean allows Mrs. Wicket into his car for a real drive, but she begins to enjoy it much more than Mr. Bean intended.

7.name: Prize Photo
7.overview: Mr. Bean learns that a prize of £500 from a magazine is available if he can get a photograph of an elusive bird. He tries to tempt the bird into his garden with some nuts, but two naughty squirrels repeatedly get in the way. Finally, he gets the photograph he wanted, but were the squirrels exactly what they seemed?

7.name: Scrapper's Snack
7.overview: Mr. Bean builds a model boat to compete in a boat race at the park, but Scrapper interferes. Mr. Bean believes he's swallowed a vital part of his model boat, but where has it really ended up?

7.name: Movie Mayhem
7.overview: Mr. Bean and Irma go out together for a night at the cinema. Mr. Bean wants to watch a scary looking alien movie, but Irma has already opted for a romantic movie. They struggle to remain calm and seated while the movies is on, and eventually find themselves moving all around the cinema.

7.name: Ghost Spotters
7.overview: Mr. Bean is unimpressed with a TV show showing a family earning a fortune for their supposedly haunted house, so he decides to make his own flat look more eerie than usual to win a fortune of his own.

7.name: Necklace Thief
7.overview: Mr. Bean offers to repair Mrs Wicket’s antique necklace, but when his back is turned, Scrapper gets entangled and runs off with it around his neck.

7.name: The Big Shrink
7.overview: When Irma leaves Mr. Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine.

7.name: Winning Ticket
7.overview: Mr. Bean runs a rigged tombola so he can raise money for a remote-controlled car.

7.name: Train Trouble
7.overview: Mr. Bean loses his ticket on a train ride and has to spend the journey hiding from the inspector.

7.name: Blown Away
7.overview: Mr. Bean tries to get rid of a pile of leaves using a leafblower.

7.name: Autograph Hunter
7.overview: When Mr. Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed – but the queue to meet him is massive!

7.name: The Sofa Stain
7.overview: As Mr. Bean tests out Mr Paliwal’s brand-new white sofa, he feels the squish of a chocolate bar in his back pocket and realises it’s gone all over the white cushions.

7.name: Bean The Pet Groomer
7.overview: When Mrs. Wicket gives Mr. Bean some cash to take Scrapper to the pet groomer’s, he can’t believe the cost! Instead he buys a basic grooming kit, pockets the rest of the cash and gives the cat a makeover himself, without Mrs. Wicket realising.

7.name: Double Date Disaster
7.overview: It’s Valentine’s Day, and Mr Bean is taking Irma to a cheap restaurant with a two-for-one deal on. But due to a mix up with the taxis they end up in a posh restaurant that Mr Paliwal had booked.

7.name: Table Tennis Trick
7.overview: Mr. Bean sees Mr. Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize.

7.name: Walking Into Trouble
7.overview: Mr. Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit.

7.name: Bean's Baby
7.overview: When Mr. Bean’s picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley.

7.name: Hiding At Home
7.overview: Mrs. Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight.

7.name: Bean's Bath Bother
7.overview: Mr. Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs. Wicket’s bathroom.

7.name: Opera For One
7.overview: Irma calls Mr. Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out.

7.name: Bean Hatches A Plan
7.overview: Mr. Bean buys a chicken but has to hide it from his allergic landlady!

7.name: Remote Control Chaos
7.overview: Mr. Bean drives a remote-controlled car straight into a birthday cake and tries to keep it secret!

7.name: Scrapper's Feeding Time
7.overview: Mr. Bean has to feed Scrapper night and day, so invents a feeding machine using a train set.

7.name: Pretend Patient
7.overview: Mr. Bean pretends to be ill to get out of a lunch with Irma’s mum.

7.name: Window of Opportunity
7.overview: Mr. Bean invents a mobile window-cleaning device to help the street win a competition.

7.name: Irma's Surprise
7.overview: Mr. Bean builds a snow sculpture for Irma, but can he stop it from melting before she sees it?

lastEpisodeToAir.name: Irma's Surprise
lastEpisodeToAir.overview: Mr. Bean builds a snow sculpture for Irma, but can he stop it from melting before she sees it?

overview: The animated daily trials and tribulations of clueless yet clever loner Mr Bean (aided by his best friend Teddy of course!) as he stumbles from one mishap to the next, always finding complex solutions to the simplest of problems.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Mr. Bean gets into all kinds of mischief with Teddy, his Mini and his landlady Mrs. Wicket. From camping and treasure hunting to wildlife photography and encounters with thieves, his everyday adventures rarely go according to plan.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Mr. Bean finds himself in new adventures involving holidays, school, technology and even a Scottish castle. Along the way, his rivalry with the Reliant and constant trouble with Mrs. Wicket and Scrapper continue.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Unlike the first two seasons, Season 3 is the first season to be broadcast daily on CITV rather than a Saturday night prime-time slot on ITV1 as well as the first to have 18 single episodes rather than back-to-back segments.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Following an 11-year hiatus, a new revived series consisting of 52 episodes each lasting for 11 minutes began broadcasting in February 2015.
